verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly list 'MCP server' as one of the tool types an Activepieces agent can attach (an external server, for systems that aren't pieces), letting agents call its tools alongside pieces and flows — this is the client-side capability the story asks for. However, most of the MCP-related evidence in the pack (docs-4, docs-27, probe-4) actually describes the reverse direction (Activepieces itself exposing an MCP server to external clients like Claude/Cursor), and there is no independent/hands-on confirmation of adding an external MCP server as an agent tool. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification of connecting an external MCP server into an agent, and more detailed first-party setup/config documentation for that specific flow.
